days.title: Southern Forests and Royal History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kottenforst
stops.detail: The southeastern part of the nature park is formed by the Kottenforst with an area of about 40 km².

stops.name: Schloss Herzogsfreude
stops.detail: The Kottenforst nature park is criss-crossed by a spider-web-like path system aligned with the former Herzogsfreude Castle in Röttgen.

stops.name: Jägerhäuschen
stops.detail: The Jägerhäuschen (hunting lodge) has been preserved as a architectural monument of these hunts.
